PLAN "Perimenopause Strength & Bone Health (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Bone-loading compound strength for perimenopause"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation & Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Full Body Compound A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          calf_stretch 1m
          chest_stretch 1m
          back_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Full Body Compound B":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x5..7 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cycling 5m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Accessory & Core":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          quad_stretch 1m
          tricep_stretch 1m
          spinal_twist 1m
